scope: Post-lock reconciliation of reported revenue values and the sensitivity of the sealed numerical baseline.

fourth_quarter_reconciliation.counterfactual: Replace reported amounts by the archived release values in a copy of each public input only when its original release date is no later than cutoff. Run the registered trend_arm for each origin, comparing ordered alert CIKs in all six sectors.

near_threshold_checks.screen: All annual-minus-nine-month quarter pairs within 0.5 percentage points of the -5.00% threshold in the private quarter export. Each directly reported consolidated-quarter pair agrees with the derived amounts.
